description: Draw an arc (Arc tool, with the Arc Segment Tool Options): the arc spans a width x height box (Length X-Axis, Length Y-Axis) from the start corner to the opposite corner. baseAlong x leaves the start point horizontally, y vertically. slope: positive is convex, negative concave, 0 a straight line. closed adds the corner the arc curves around (a pie-slice shape). With fill, the arc is filled (Fill Arc)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

baseAlong.description: Base Along: the axis the arc leaves its start point along. Default x

closed.description: Type: true for a closed arc, false for open. Default false

fill.description: Fill. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

layer.description: Layer to draw on. Default: the active layer

name.description: Name for the new item (shown in the Layers panel)

slope.description: Slope, -100 (concave) to 100 (convex). About 55 approximates a quarter ellipse. Default 50

startCorner.description: Corner of the box where the arc starts (the dialog's reference point). Default top_left

stroke.description: Stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

x.description: Left edge of the box, points from the artboard's left

y.description: Top edge of the box, points from the artboard's top

name: create_arc
title: Create Arc
